## Decisions
- Looks apply is refused (not silently allowed) on audio-track clips → because every look is Color-category-only by construction, so it would always be a no-op that misleadingly reports success; matches how the Inspector/Effects menu already filter via `EffectRelevance`.
- Backup-before-overwrite uses a single `.bak` file (not timestamped/rotating) → simplest fix matching the review's ask; only triggers once per "bad load" event (tracked via `_backupPending` flag), not on every subsequent save.
- Did not implement cross-process merge-on-save or LUT path hardening (UNC/device-path rejection) in this pass → scoped out as "known gaps" since (a) cross-process contention is a pre-existing pattern shared with other app-wide stores (e.g. export presets) and out of scope to fix here alone, and (b) LUT path hardening belongs in `CreativeLuts.Load` shared with project-file LUT paths, not a looks-specific patch — flagged for a follow-up.
- Inspector "Save Look…" entry point intentionally NOT added — it was never in `plan/features/looks-browser.md`'s scope; only the browser's own button exists.
- Left `tests/Sprocket.Persistence.Tests/.impeccable/` and the old context-save markdown untracked/unstaged — unrelated to this feature, not committed.
